role_title: Senior Product Manager (Sage Intacct Budgeting & Planning)

must_have.evidence_summary: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering from Manipal Institute of Technology (2011–2015).

must_have.requirement: 7+ years of experience in B2B product management and product delivery, working for a SaaS/Cloud company with modern agile practices.
must_have.evidence_summary: 10+ years across product development, SaaS/AI workflow consulting, and enterprise platform PM (Byju's 2015–2023, Hype 2023–2024, Lowe's India 2024–Present). While SaaS and Enterprise Platforms are core domains, a significant portion of earlier PM tenure was in EdTech/B2C alongside enterprise B2B internal platforms at Lowe's and B2B consulting at Hype.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Emphasize enterprise B2B platform delivery at Lowe's India, SaaS consulting at Hype, and agile product lifecycle ownership across 10+ years.

must_have.requirement: Practical experience using AI tools to accelerate product management work, alongside judgment to identify and scope where AI/ML can meaningfully improve the product itself.
must_have.evidence_summary: Designed and launched an AI-driven procurement and catalog system (reducing cycle times by 20%) and automated recovery workflows (~$10M annual savings) at Lowe's India.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Directly demonstrate scoping and shipping high-ROI AI workflow improvements in enterprise products.

must_have.requirement: Collaborate with Business Operations, IT Operations, Support, Sales, and Product Marketing Management on provisioning, onboarding, tenant management, integrations, and launches.
must_have.evidence_summary: Coordinated finance, operations, engineering, and IT stakeholders at Lowe's India on enterprise asset lifecycle and store setup procurement platforms, and led Product Marketing and GTM strategies at Hype and Byju's.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Highlight cross-functional leadership spanning IT operations, finance, business operations, and product marketing.

must_have.requirement: Administer and oversee beta/preview programs, usability studies, business workflow research, and internal training/readiness for new product features.
must_have.evidence_summary: Developed 12 cross-product prototypes, led UX optimization and app redesigns (Tynker +5% completion), and launched Interactive Learning Experiences reducing instructor training time by 15% at WhiteHat Jr. Formal B2B SaaS beta program administration is adjacent.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Bridge from prototyping (12 cross-product prototypes), iterative experimentation, UX research, and internal enablement/training optimization (-15% training time).

preferred.requirement: Experience with Budgeting and Planning applications, understanding of multi-dimensional financial concepts, and background in Accounting / FP&A / budgeting.
preferred.evidence_summary: Owned P&L responsibilities, managed forecasting, budgeting, headcount planning, and ROI evaluation across product and operational initiatives, and partnered with finance stakeholders on an enterprise asset lifecycle platform delivering $2M annual savings. However, has not built commercial FP&A or multi-dimensional accounting software.
preferred.positioning_bridge: Bridge practitioner experience in P&L ownership, forecasting, budgeting, and finance stakeholder partnership at Lowe's to the customer persona of Sage Intacct Budgeting & Planning.

implicit.requirement: Write detailed requirement documents for engineering to implement business operations enhancements and integrations, tracking post-launch success metrics.
implicit.evidence_summary: Owned strategic roadmaps, KPI frameworks, and enterprise workflow systems across engineering and operations at Lowe's India.
implicit.positioning_bridge: Directly supported by enterprise platform delivery and KPI governance.

domain.requirement: B2B SaaS Financial Management, ERP, and FP&A Budgeting & Planning Software.
domain.evidence_summary: Experienced in enterprise financial/business operations (forecasting, budgeting, P&L ownership, finance-partnered asset lifecycle platform saving $2M/yr at Lowe's), though not prior ownership of an external commercial FP&A SaaS product.
domain.positioning_bridge: Position deep internal enterprise finance/operations platform experience and P&L/budgeting fluency as strong domain-adjacent credibility.
